media.alt: Text-led reel styled as a go/no-go launch board, with the K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top of every frame and a row of seven check lamps at the bottom. Hook: What we check before a website goes live. 7 checks, shown on a site we built, thrillersvr.com, beside the Thrillers Mobile VR home page on a phone. Check 1, Tab through it: the site's Skip to content link and its Book the trailer button, each with a focus ring. Check 2, the 10-second phone test: the first phone screen, What: a mobile VR trailer, Where: Middleburg, FL. Check 3, Contrast: the site's text colors measured, headline 17.23:1, body text 7.83:1, buttons 16.58:1, form hints 7.55:1, WCAG asks for 4.5:1. Check 4, Every link returns 200: six pages, each 200 OK. Check 5, The form sends: the booking form empty, in focus, with an email error, and ready; field states only, nothing was sent. Check 6, The 404 page: Error 404, wrong turn, with two ways back. Each of these is stamped Pass. Check 7, Speed on a phone: frames of the page loading on a simulated phone, More on that soon. Ends on Launching a website? We run every check before it goes live. Want a site built and checked? Call Alex 904-210-1071, ka-performancefl.com. More quick fixes on YouTube: @KAPerformancefl.
